lifecycle.title: From “we need to learn” to <hl>“here’s what to do”</hl>
lifecycle.subtitle: One continuous journey — no more jumping between docs, form tools, spreadsheets, and Word.

plan.title: Start with the decision
plan.body: Describe what you need to learn. Survai turns that into clear objectives, audiences, and sections — so you stop writing questions before you know why.
plan.line1: Goal: Understand barriers to program uptake

build.title: Get a first draft in minutes
build.body: AI proposes questions you can keep, edit, or replace. Build manually anytime — you never lose control of the survey.
build.line2: What made it hard to attend sessions?

review.title: Catch weak questions early
review.body: Spot leading wording, double-barreled asks, and surveys that run too long — before respondents ever see them.
review.line2: “Don’t you agree the training was useful?”

collect.title: Share a link. Get answers.
collect.body: Publish once, share a link or QR, and collect on phone or laptop. Respondents need no account.

analyze.title: See what the data actually says
analyze.body: Distributions, filters, and comparisons calculated from real responses — so you spend time interpreting, not wrestling spreadsheets.
analyze.line2: Distance cited by 41% as a barrier
analyze.line3: Ready to explore by gender · location

report.title: Turn findings into a story
report.body: Generate a structured report for donors, boards, or your team — then chat with it to pull the right takeaway for each audience.

contrast.title: Stop stitching tools. Start shipping <hl>answers</hl>
contrast.subtitle: Same research goal. Two ways of working. Hover or tap a side to see the difference.

fragmented.label: The old way
fragmented.point1: Plan in docs, build in a form tool, analyze in sheets
fragmented.point2: Weeks writing the donor report by hand
fragmented.point3: Hundreds of responses — still unclear what to do next

survai.label: Survai
survai.point1: Plan, build, collect, analyze, and report in one place
survai.point2: Draft reports in minutes — numbers stay tied to your data
survai.point3: Chat with findings to brief donors, boards, or your team

trust.title: Evidence you can <gold>act on</gold>
trust.subtitle: Built for program, research, and policy teams who need answers — not another pile of responses with no clear next step.

speed.title: Faster from goal to draft
speed.body: Stop starting from a blank page. Describe what you need to learn and get a clear plan and first-draft survey you can reshape in minutes.

evidence.title: Findings you can stand behind
evidence.body: Every chart and percentage comes from your collected responses — not from an AI guessing. Reports stay tied to real results.

approval.title: You approve before it ships
approval.body: AI suggests, drafts, and explains. You edit, reject, or accept before anything goes live or lands in a donor report.

demo.title: See how respondents will answer <hl>your questions</hl>
demo.subtitle: Try a few question types — the same clear experience your community gets on a phone or laptop.
demo.qSingle: What was the main reason you joined this program?
demo.qRating: How useful was the training for your daily work?
demo.qOpen: What would make it easier for you to participate next time?

collect.title: Collect in the field without the <hl>chaos</hl>
collect.subtitle: Publish when ready, share a link or QR, and close the round when outreach ends — no orphaned open forms.

draft.label: Draft
draft.detail: Shape questions privately until the survey feels right.

publish.label: Publish
publish.detail: Go live when you’re ready — respondents see a clear, stable form.

share.label: Share
share.detail: Send a link or print a QR. No account needed to answer.

close.label: Close
close.detail: End collection when outreach wraps. Your responses stay safe.

principles.title: How we earn your trust
principles.body: The same standards we’d want if our own program evidence were on the line — for boards, donors, and communities.

decide.title: AI assists — you decide
decide.body: Suggestions, drafts, and explanations are always editable. Nothing publishes or reports without your judgment.

numbers.title: Numbers come from your data
numbers.body: Counts, percentages, and charts are calculated from real responses — never invented to fill a narrative.

simple.title: Simple enough for busy teams
simple.body: You don’t need a research degree to run a solid survey. Clear defaults; deeper tools when you want them.

respect.title: Respect for respondents
respect.body: Collect only what you need. Share a simple link. Keep sensitive answers under your organization’s control.

audience.title: Built for teams who turn surveys into <hl>decisions</hl>
audience.subtitle: Shaped with Ethiopian civil society organizations — designed for research and program teams everywhere.

me.title: Program & M&E officers
me.body: Move from research goal to donor-ready report without losing weeks in spreadsheets and Word drafts.

cso.title: CSOs & NGOs

faq.title: Good questions before you <gold>start</gold>
faq.subtitle: What Survai is for, how AI fits in, and what respondents experience.

problem.a: Most teams plan in documents, build in a form tool, analyze in spreadsheets, then write the report by hand. Survai connects that whole journey — from research goal to actionable findings — in one place.

numbers.q: Will AI invent numbers in my reports?
numbers.a: No. AI helps with planning, question wording, review suggestions, and narrative writing. Every count and percentage comes from your collected responses — or it isn’t shown.

account.a: No. You publish a survey and share a link or QR. People answer on phone or laptop without signing up. You can close the round when collection ends.

who.a: Program and M&E officers, CSOs and NGOs, researchers, and policy teams — anyone who needs clearer surveys and reports they can take to donors, boards, or partners.

ready.a: Survai is in active development, shaped with Ethiopian civil society organizations. Core flows from planning through collection are live; analysis and reporting continue to deepen with pilot partners.
